name: Telah
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Telah was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Joseph, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Ephraim in 1 Chronicles. He is part of the genealogical line that leads to Joshua (Hosea), the son of Nun. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Telah is mentioned as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Ephraim, as the son of Reseph and father of Tahan.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Line to Joshua
keyEvents.description: Telah is part of the genealogical chain connecting Ephraim with Joshua (son of Nun), Israel's leader during the conquest of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Family and the Tragedy
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Ephraim experienced tragedies, including the loss of sons who were killed by men from Gath. Telah is part of the lineage that continued Ephraim's line after this event.

keyEvents.title: Preservation of Ephraim's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Through Telah and his descendants, the tribal line of Ephraim was preserved, which was crucial for Israel's tribal structure and inheritance.
